progress

Progress bar.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
percent Number No Percentage. The value ranges from 0 to 100.
show-info Boolean false No Whether to display percentages on the right of the progress bar.
border-radius Number/String 0 No Fillet size.
font-size Number/String 16 No Percentage font size on the right.
stroke-width Number/String 6 No Width of the progress bar.
activeColor String #09BB07 No Color of the selected progress bar.
backgroundColor String #EBEBEB No Color of the unselected progress bar.
active Boolean false No Animation of the progress bar from left to right.
active-mode String backwards No backwards: The animation is played from the beginning.forwards: The animation is played from the last end point.
duration Number 30 No Time required for a 1% increase in progress, in milliseconds.
bindactiveend EventHandle No Animation completion event.

Sample Code


<view>
  <progress fontSize='20' percent='20' show-info strokeWidth='2' />
</view>
